raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since about 2026-01-17 the source records reversals as new rows with status 'REVERSAL' and an orig_txn_id. The original rows stay 'POSTED'. The silver filter keeps only POSTED, so reversed originals are still counted and gold totals run higher than settlement. Older reversals arrive as 'REVERSED' and are already excluded.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id);"}}
